**What this changes**

**Evidence**
- [ ] Before and after screenshots from the viewer, taken off-centre (if it changes how a world looks, sounds or moves)
- [ ] The prompt or photos used
- [ ] Build time and peak memory (if it touches the pipeline)

**The rules**
- [ ] Peak memory stays under 48 GB
- [ ] Only open models; any new one is named with its size and licence
- [ ] Nothing calls out to the network
- [ ] Unit tests pass
